description: R58 P0-5 error protocol baseline (按 domain 分类,security/destructive/data-integrity/financial 目标为 0,ratchet 下降)
note: R58 P0-5: fail-open/except pass/return 0|False 按 domain 分类管理。零容忍域 (security/destructive/data-integrity/financial) 目标 max_violations=0;采用 ratchet 策略:current <= baseline_violations 即通过,任何新增违规阻断 CI。observability best-effort 允许通过 max_violations 放行。修复后运行 --generate-baseline 下降 baseline_violations。
ratchet_strategy: zero-tolerance domains: current_count <= baseline_violations (block new debt); observability: current_count <= max_violations

security.description: 认证、授权、MFA、密码、token、签名验证相关

destructive.description: 删除、清除、purge、reset 等不可逆操作

data-integrity.description: 备份、恢复、事务、outbox、数据一致性

financial.description: 配额、计费、积分等财务相关

observability.description: 日志、metric、trace 等可观测性 best-effort
